---
name: Propose a map change
about: A classification, a house rule, a new circle, a relabel or a reframing on any map
labels: map change
---

**Map** (Taxonomy, Networks, Web3, Adoption, Privacy, Identity, Architecture, Quantum, Scenarios)

**What the map says today** (quote the circle, badge, lens note or dial reading, with the page URL)

**Proposed change**

**Why** (the rule, standard, legal text or market practice it rests on; say if it is a matter of judgment rather than fact)

**Sources read** (one per line: URL, what it shows, date read)

**Who it affects** (which badges, lenses or scenarios would read differently)
